name: Hercules, Olympian Hero
oracle_text:
Whenever Hercules attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on him. He gains indestructible until end of turn.
Whenever Hercules is dealt damage for the first time each turn, put that many +1/+1 counters on him. (He must survive the damage to get the counters.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever Hercules is dealt damage for the first time each turn, put that many +1/+1 counters on him. (He must survive the damage to get the counters.)

needs.what: a 'this permanent is dealt damage' trigger that fires once per simultaneous damage event (e.g. one combat damage step, 510.2) with its `amount` binding the TOTAL damage dealt to it in that event across all sources, so 'for the first time each turn' plus 'put that many' counts every blocker's damage, not just the first source's
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `dealt_damage` with `source: self` fires one DAMAGE_DEALT per (source, recipient), so `max_per_turn: 1` keeps only the first source's event and `{binding: amount}` reads that one source's damage; a Hercules blocked by two creatures would get counters for one blocker only. `batched` keys on `event.data.batch`, which damage events do not carry, and would still bind only the first event's amount. `damage_taken_this_turn` sums damage to players, not to a permanent.
